query_analysis.original_query: I'm designing a membrane filtration system for challenging liquid-solid separations. What multi-scale modeling approaches could help us predict performance across different operating conditions?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine suitable multi-scale modeling approaches to predict the performance of a membrane filtration system designed for challenging liquid-solid separations under different operating conditions, to enhance system design and optimization.

selected_agents.role: Lead membrane filtration system design and process understanding
Develop multi-scale models for performance prediction

communication_strategy.information_flow: Integration of modeling results into system design and performance prediction
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative modeling and design optimization through collaborative feedback

clarification_questions: What is the composition and particle size distribution of the solids in the feed stream?
What specific operating conditions (pressure, temperature, flow rates) are being considered?
Are there specific scales (microscopic, mesoscopic, macroscopic) you wish the modeling to focus on?
